info.name: CacheDB Oracle - Catalog 0.14
info.description: Self-contained 0.14 feature flow. Requires the demo profile and initialized SQL schema, but not demo seed data. Imports four new products atomically, checks replay and changed-payload rejection, explicitly prepares a Jackson-free snapshot and reads its typed results. Run the whole collection; polling is bounded to 30 seconds per job. This is not a latency benchmark.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 202) { pm.collectionVariables.set('catalogJobId', pm.response.json().jobId); pm.collectionVariables.set('catalogPolls', 0); pm.collectionVariables.set('catalogPollDeadline', Date.now() + 30000); pm.test('Job is accepted, not a SQL commit', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Location')).to.include('/api/warm/jobs/')); }
pm.collectionVariables.set('catalogDurabilityDeadline', Date.now() + 30000);
pm.test('Accepted', () => pm.response.to.have.status(202));
pm.test('Job status available', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
const job = pm.response.json(); const n = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('catalogPolls') || 0) + 1; pm.collectionVariables.set('catalogPolls', n);

if (!['COMPLETED','FAILED'].includes(job.status) && n < 150 && Date.now() < Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('catalogPollDeadline'))) { setTimeout(() => pm.execution.setNextRequest(pm.info.requestName), 200); } else { pm.test('Atomic batch accepted with explicit durability state', () => { pm.expect(job.status).to.eql('COMPLETED'); pm.expect(job.result.outcome).to.eql('ACCEPTED'); pm.expect(job.result.durable).to.be.a('boolean'); }); if (job.result) pm.collectionVariables.set('catalogReceipt', JSON.stringify(job.result.receipt)); }
pm.test('Accepted', () => pm.response.to.have.status(202));
const job = pm.response.json(); const n = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('catalogPolls') || 0) + 1; pm.collectionVariables.set('catalogPolls', n);

if (!['COMPLETED','FAILED'].includes(job.status) && n < 150 && Date.now() < Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('catalogPollDeadline'))) { setTimeout(() => pm.execution.setNextRequest(pm.info.requestName), 200); } else if (job.status === 'COMPLETED' && job.result.outcome === 'ACCEPTED' && !job.result.durable && Date.now() < Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('catalogDurabilityDeadline'))) { pm.execution.setNextRequest('03 Replay identical import'); } else { pm.test('Replay retained versions and SQL durability is confirmed', () => { pm.expect(job.status).to.eql('COMPLETED'); pm.expect(job.result.receipt).to.deep.eql(JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('catalogReceipt'))); pm.expect(job.result.durable).to.eql(true); }); }

item.name: 05 Reject changed payload under the same batch ID

exec: pm.test('Only job submission accepted', () => pm.response.to.have.status(202));
const job = pm.response.json(); const n = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('catalogPolls') || 0) + 1; pm.collectionVariables.set('catalogPolls', n);

if (!['COMPLETED','FAILED'].includes(job.status) && n < 150 && Date.now() < Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('catalogPollDeadline'))) { setTimeout(() => pm.execution.setNextRequest(pm.info.requestName), 200); } else { pm.test('Conflicting retry is rejected', () => { pm.expect(job.status).to.eql('COMPLETED'); pm.expect(job.result.outcome).to.eql('REJECTED'); pm.expect(job.result.message).to.include('Batch id reused'); }); }
pm.test('Preparation submitted', () => pm.response.to.have.status(202));
const job = pm.response.json(); const n = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('catalogPolls') || 0) + 1; pm.collectionVariables.set('catalogPolls', n);

if (!['COMPLETED','FAILED'].includes(job.status) && n < 150 && Date.now() < Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('catalogPollDeadline'))) { setTimeout(() => pm.execution.setNextRequest(pm.info.requestName), 200); } else { pm.test('Snapshot published', () => { pm.expect(job.status).to.eql('COMPLETED'); pm.expect(job.result.submittedRows).to.be.at.least(4); }); }

item.name: 09 Read typed Unicode and decimal card

exec: pm.test('Typed card from Redis', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('FOUND'); pm.expect(b.values[0].name).to.eql('İğne çelik'); pm.expect(b.values[0].unitPrice).to.eql(12.3456); pm.expect(b.values[0].available).to.eql(6); pm.expect(b).not.to.have.property('rawPayload'); });

item.name: 10 Read two cards from the same generation

exec: pm.test('Single-generation batch', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b['9100001'].generation).to.eql(b['9100003'].generation); });

pm.test('Bounded page with cursor', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.items).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(b.nextCursor).to.be.a('string'); pm.collectionVariables.set('catalogCursor', b.nextCursor); });
pm.test('Second item', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().items[0].values[0].productId).to.eql(9100002); });
pm.test('Known catalog, absent root', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('ABSENT_IN_GENERATION'); });
pm.test('Explicit page limit', () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));
pm.test('Empty batch is not queued', () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));

item.name: 16 Reject extreme numeric exponent before queueing

exec: pm.test('NUMERIC(19,4) bound cannot overflow', () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));
